items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I met Oscar when he was... [INTERVIEWER] You meant Adolphus Allsbrook. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Right... That's the first time we met.

ctx.x: Well, I met the Pettifords in Oklahoma originally. I met Oscar when he was...
Yeah. Right. Oscar played bass horn. And man, he was so little, I couldn't see how he could even play the bass horn. That's the first time we met. Then I knew all his sisters... He had a...
